text.en: The sitio of Hipantag in the barrio of Benit, Municipality of Sogod, Province of Southern Leyte, is separated from said barrio and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the barrio of Hipantag.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
